reading: The supplied account reports the abrupt departure of Nvidia’s chief executive, portraying it as a severe reversal for the AI chipmaking giant.
It links the reported crisis to concerns about professional boundaries and possible national security risks.
According to the account, Nvidia has come under scrutiny from US lawmakers seeking answers about a possible connection to Chinese intelligence.
The text reports that US Attorney General Todd Blanche said the Department of Justice had not yet drawn any conclusions about whether Alice Huang had engaged in espionage for Beijing.
It also says several lawmakers demanded that the departing executive brief Congress on the matter.
Should the executive refuse to appear voluntarily, he could be subpoenaed, meaning formally ordered to attend, according to a Senate staff member cited in the account.
The account says Nvidia saw no reason to believe national security or company secrets had been compromised, while pledging that an independent investigation would consider all available information.
It reports that the executive had initially been expected to weather the storm while the company investigated whether he had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.
An employee cited in the text says initial reports about the executive’s private conduct were largely brushed off by rank-and-file workers.
The account notes that many employees had earned millions through their ability to cash out company stock as its value soared.
It describes a succession process in which Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress took temporary charge while Nvidia sought a permanent replacement.
According to the supplied figures, Nvidia’s value had risen by more than 470% over five years and was now down by 31% against a backdrop of wider uncertainty in the technology sector.
The account says Nvidia represents about 7% of the S&P 500 index, which is available through a popular index fund used in US retirement savings accounts.
It explains that those retirement account balances fluctuate with stock market movements.

vocabulary.definition: Limits on workplace conduct intended to prevent personal relationships from interfering with professional responsibilities.
Being examined closely, especially because conduct or decisions have raised concerns.
Give members of Congress a focused account of relevant information about a particular matter.
Formally required by a legal order to appear or provide evidence; here, required to attend.
Survive a period of serious difficulty without losing one’s position or ability to continue.
An organised attempt by another country’s intelligence services to obtain information or exert influence.
Dismissed as insufficiently important to deserve serious attention, without necessarily being disproved.
Describing ordinary members of an organisation, as distinct from those in senior positions.
Convert an investment into money by selling it, thereby realising its current value.
The process through which one person replaces another in a position of authority.
Within a wider situation that provides relevant context without necessarily establishing a direct cause.

entries.ja: 私的な人間関係が職務上の責任を果たす妨げにならないように設けられた、職場での行動上の限度。
entries.ko: 개인적인 관계가 직무상 책임을 수행하는 데 지장을 주지 않도록 정한 직장 내 행동의 한계.
entries.zh-Hans: 为防止私人关系妨碍履行工作职责而设定的职场行为界限。
entries.es: Límites de conducta en el trabajo destinados a evitar que las relaciones personales interfieran con las responsabilidades profesionales.
entries.pt-BR: Limites de conduta no trabalho destinados a impedir que relações pessoais interfiram nas responsabilidades profissionais.
entries.fr: Limites de conduite au travail visant à empêcher que les relations personnelles ne nuisent à l’exercice des responsabilités professionnelles.
entries.de: Grenzen für das Verhalten am Arbeitsplatz, die verhindern sollen, dass persönliche Beziehungen die Erfüllung beruflicher Pflichten beeinträchtigen.

entries.ja: 特に行動や判断が懸念を招いたために、詳しく調べられている状態。
entries.ko: 특히 행동이나 결정이 우려를 불러일으켜 면밀히 검토되고 있는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在受到仔细审查，尤其是因为某些行为或决定引发了担忧。
entries.es: Estar siendo examinado de cerca, especialmente porque ciertas conductas o decisiones han suscitado preocupación.
entries.pt-BR: Estar sendo examinado de perto, especialmente porque certas condutas ou decisões geraram preocupação.
entries.fr: Faire l’objet d’un examen attentif, notamment parce que des comportements ou des décisions ont suscité des inquiétudes.
entries.de: Genau geprüft werden, insbesondere weil Verhaltensweisen oder Entscheidungen Anlass zur Sorge gegeben haben.

entries.ja: 特定の事柄に関する情報を、要点を絞って米国の連邦議会議員に説明すること。
entries.ko: 특정 사안과 관련된 정보를 핵심 위주로 미국 연방의회 의원들에게 설명하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 向美国国会议员简明扼要地说明与某一具体事项有关的信息。
entries.es: Dar a los miembros del Congreso de Estados Unidos una explicación centrada en la información pertinente sobre un asunto concreto.
entries.pt-BR: Apresentar aos membros do Congresso dos Estados Unidos um relato focado nas informações relevantes sobre determinado assunto.
entries.fr: Présenter aux membres du Congrès des États-Unis un exposé ciblé des informations pertinentes sur une affaire précise.
entries.de: Mitgliedern des US-Kongresses einen auf das Wesentliche konzentrierten Bericht mit relevanten Informationen zu einer bestimmten Angelegenheit geben.

entries.ja: 法的な命令によって、出頭または証拠の提出を正式に義務づけられたこと。ここでは、出席を義務づけられたこと。
entries.ko: 법적 명령에 따라 출석하거나 증거를 제출하도록 공식적으로 요구받은 상태. 여기서는 출석하도록 요구받았다는 뜻.
entries.zh-Hans: 已被法律命令正式要求到场或提供证据；此处指被要求到场。
entries.es: Haber recibido una orden legal que exige formalmente comparecer o aportar pruebas; aquí, que exige asistir.
entries.pt-BR: Ter recebido uma ordem legal que exige formalmente o comparecimento ou a apresentação de provas; aqui, que exige o comparecimento.
entries.fr: Avoir reçu une injonction légale imposant officiellement de comparaître ou de fournir des preuves ; ici, de se présenter.
entries.de: Durch eine rechtliche Anordnung förmlich zum Erscheinen oder zur Vorlage von Beweisen verpflichtet worden sein; hier zur Teilnahme verpflichtet worden sein.

entries.ja: 自分の地位や活動を続ける力を失うことなく、深刻な困難の時期を乗り切ること。
entries.ko: 자신의 지위나 계속해 나갈 능력을 잃지 않고 심각한 어려움의 시기를 견뎌 내다.
entries.zh-Hans: 在不失去自身职位或继续下去的能力的情况下，渡过一段严重困难的时期。
entries.es: Superar un período de graves dificultades sin perder el puesto ni la capacidad de seguir adelante.
entries.pt-BR: Superar um período de grandes dificuldades sem perder o cargo ou a capacidade de continuar.
entries.fr: Traverser une période de graves difficultés sans perdre sa position ni sa capacité à poursuivre ses activités.
entries.de: Eine Phase schwerer Schwierigkeiten überstehen, ohne die eigene Position oder die Fähigkeit zum Weitermachen zu verlieren.

entries.ja: 他国の情報機関が、情報を得たり影響力を及ぼしたりするために行う組織的な試み。
entries.ko: 다른 나라의 정보기관이 정보를 얻거나 영향력을 행사하기 위해 벌이는 조직적인 시도.
entries.zh-Hans: 他国情报机构为获取信息或施加影响而进行的有组织的尝试。
entries.es: Intento organizado de los servicios de inteligencia de otro país de obtener información o ejercer influencia.
entries.pt-BR: Tentativa organizada dos serviços de inteligência de outro país de obter informações ou exercer influência.
entries.fr: Tentative organisée des services de renseignement d’un autre pays pour obtenir des informations ou exercer une influence.
entries.de: Ein organisierter Versuch der Nachrichtendienste eines anderen Landes, Informationen zu beschaffen oder Einfluss auszuüben.

entries.ja: 真剣に取り合うほど重要ではないとして退けられたこと。ただし、誤りだと証明されたとは限らない。
entries.ko: 진지하게 주의를 기울일 만큼 중요하지 않다고 여겨져 일축된 상태. 반드시 사실이 아니라고 입증된 것은 아님.
entries.zh-Hans: 被认为不够重要、不值得认真对待而遭到忽视，但并不一定已被证明不实。
entries.es: Descartado por considerarse que no tiene suficiente importancia como para merecer una atención seria, sin que necesariamente se haya demostrado su falsedad.
entries.pt-BR: Descartado por ser considerado sem importância suficiente para merecer atenção séria, sem que sua falsidade tenha sido necessariamente comprovada.
entries.fr: Écarté comme trop peu important pour mériter une attention sérieuse, sans que sa fausseté ait nécessairement été démontrée.
entries.de: Als zu unwichtig abgetan, um ernsthafte Beachtung zu verdienen, ohne unbedingt widerlegt worden zu sein.

entries.ja: 組織の中で、上層部の役職に就いている人ではなく、一般の構成員に当たること。
entries.ko: 조직에서 고위직에 있는 사람들과 구별되는 일반 구성원을 가리킴.
entries.zh-Hans: 指组织中的普通成员，有别于担任高级职务的人。
entries.es: Que corresponde a los miembros comunes de una organización, a diferencia de quienes ocupan cargos superiores.
entries.pt-BR: Que se refere aos membros comuns de uma organização, em contraste com aqueles que ocupam cargos superiores.
entries.fr: Qui concerne les membres ordinaires d’une organisation, par opposition à ceux qui occupent des postes élevés.
entries.de: Die einfachen Mitglieder einer Organisation betreffend, im Unterschied zu Personen in höheren Positionen.

entries.ja: 投資している資産を売却して現金に換え、その時点の価値を実際のお金として得ること。
entries.ko: 투자 자산을 팔아 현금으로 바꾸어 현재의 가치를 실제 돈으로 확보하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过出售投资资产将其变成现金，从而把当前价值转化为实际所得。
entries.es: Convertir una inversión en dinero vendiéndola y obtener así su valor actual en efectivo.
entries.pt-BR: Transformar um investimento em dinheiro por meio de sua venda, recebendo assim seu valor atual em dinheiro.
entries.fr: Convertir un placement en argent en le vendant, et ainsi obtenir sa valeur actuelle sous forme d’argent.
entries.de: Eine Geldanlage durch Verkauf in Geld umwandeln und dadurch ihren aktuellen Wert tatsächlich erhalten.

entries.ja: 権限のある地位を、ある人から別の人が引き継ぐ過程。
entries.ko: 권한이 있는 직위에서 한 사람이 다른 사람을 대신하게 되는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个人接替另一个人担任有权职务的过程。
entries.es: Proceso por el que una persona reemplaza a otra en un puesto de autoridad.
entries.pt-BR: Processo pelo qual uma pessoa substitui outra em um cargo de autoridade.
entries.fr: Processus par lequel une personne en remplace une autre à un poste d’autorité.
entries.de: Der Vorgang, bei dem eine Person eine andere in einer Position mit Entscheidungsbefugnis ablöst.

entries.ja: 関連する背景となる、より広い状況の中で。ただし、その状況が直接の原因だと示すとは限らない。
entries.ko: 관련 배경이 되는 더 넓은 상황 속에서. 다만 그 상황이 직접적인 원인임을 뜻하는 것은 아님.
entries.zh-Hans: 处于提供相关背景的更广泛形势之中，但并不一定表明该形势是直接原因。
entries.es: En una situación más amplia que aporta un contexto pertinente, sin que ello implique necesariamente una causa directa.
entries.pt-BR: Em uma situação mais ampla que fornece um contexto relevante, sem que isso estabeleça necessariamente uma causa direta.
entries.fr: Dans une situation plus générale qui fournit un contexte pertinent, sans pour autant établir nécessairement une cause directe.
entries.de: Innerhalb einer umfassenderen Situation, die einen relevanten Zusammenhang liefert, ohne damit zwangsläufig eine direkte Ursache aufzuzeigen.
